Jaekyung.name: Jaekyung

Sahyun.note: called him Dad until told to use his name

notes: Halfling fox demon, adult, works a part-time/service job; fox ears when aroused.
Runs the restaurant Slacker's alone as its cook; fox ears and tail come out when frightened.
Ch.3: abandoned as a halfling child in a forest, taken in by Sahyun; raised with help of an elderly demon neighbour; remembers only clinging to whoever abandoned him.
Ch.6: is 30 years old; has an erotic dream about the demon and is mortified when the demon notices.
Ch.7: his restaurant Slacker's opens at midnight; most customers are demons in their true forms. Haggles with Mr. Hwang, a frog-demon fishmonger.
Ch.9: frightened of the parasol-carrying broker demon; suspects he is the demon's lover ('gigolo'), gets flicked on the forehead for his 'filthy mind'.
Ch.14: dreams of fleeing overseas with Wonyoung, but Wonyoung's contract can only be nullified if the demon wishes it, and Jaekyung himself belongs to Sahyun.
Ch.22: never had family outings as a child because Sahyun refused crowded places; envied classmates' vacations.

Ch.23: halflings age more slowly than humans, so he cannot keep long-term human friendships; a college friend, now a middle-aged father, mistook him for his own son's age. Has never met another halfling besides the old lady next door; muses about a demon marriage agency.
Ch.24: has almost no demonic energy (not suppressed, simply lacking); survived only thanks to Sahyun. Yet Wonyoung insists Jaekyung awakened him; Jaekyung had no idea.

Demon.name: Demon
notes: Nameless superior demon who appears before Jaekyung, calls him 'my property' and takes over his home.
Ch.4: vain about his looks and fashion through every era; stung at being called tacky, goes shopping with Jaekyung's money and draws admirers.
Ch.5: refuses to give his name; Jaekyung dubs him 'Kim Anon' (Kim Vô Danh / Ông Vô Danh). Decides to stay in the house to rest, since Sahyun is away.

Ch.8: sells a precious red gem to a demon broker who runs a cafe; gets cash, a phone, and ID/passport arranged. Has been using Jaekyung's card. Notices he feels oddly content and uninterested in desire.
Ch.10: now wears modern clothes, owns a new smartphone bought with Jaekyung's card, opens a bank account for in-app purchases.

Ch.21: Demon Network calls him the great demon 'L' (photo taken in Myeong-dong); about 2,000 years old, says he did 'annihilate humanity' things ~1,000 years ago but mellowed; loves modern food, gadgets and TV.

Ch.25: getting a driver's license (aced written and skills tests), browsing Ferraris; asset managers in Hong Kong; can make money selling demonic energy crystals. Calls Wonyoung his weapon and says transforming him without permission is theft.

Ch.26: gained power over millennia by killing; his kills let 'something' possess Wonyoung, so he entrusted Wonyoung to Sahyun, who absorbed the murderous karma to keep his own illness at bay. Needs a demon of his caliber to fully recover; plans to impregnate Jaekyung and absorb the clone he bears.

Wonyoung.name: Wonyoung
notes: House-protector demon of Jaekyung's home (white hair); the superior demon is his original master; wears the face of someone the demon knows.
Ch.3: originally a sword kept in the house's sheath; became a black cluster, then a cat, then his current human form. He is the 'thing' the demon came to reclaim.
Ch.11: a weapon sworn to his master, neither human nor demon; cannot refuse the demon's orders.

Ch.19: in Jaekyung's childhood he was first a floating spiky blob, then a cat, then took a human form copying Sahyun's face because he knew few faces; his true form is the sword kept in the storage room.
Ch.24: a conscious blade with a soul since his forging; took Sahyun's image from long years with him. Says it was Jaekyung, as a child, who awakened him and gave him human form, not Sahyun.

Sahyun.name: Sahyun

Jaekyung.note: guardian, aloof; flashback to Jaekyung's childhood

notes: Ancient demon, prickly and apathetic, currently slumbering elsewhere; kept something for the superior demon in Jaekyung's house.

Ch.18 (flashback): raised the child Jaekyung in a countryside village beside a horse-demon clan's territory; told him not to call him Dad, just Sahyun; aloof but stayed by his side. Wonyoung first appeared in their home when Jaekyung wished for a friend.

Ch.20 (flashback): though he loathed the city, moved there with Jaekyung when he got into college; painted a scroll as a barrier for his restaurant; never affectionate but quietly provided everything.
Ch.25: old demons slumber for long periods; Sahyun promised to wake early but will sleep at least another decade.
Ch.26: avoided killing; powerful demons who do not kill lose lifespan, so absorbing Wonyoung's karma and power kept him alive.

Hyunseok.name: Hyunseok
notes: Ch.17: horse demon, Jaekyung's childhood friend from his hometown; runs a farm there and delivers produce, sends Jaekyung strawberries. Big and cheerful, lifts Jaekyung up whenever they meet.
Ch.19: was the leader of the horse-demon kids at high school; Jaekyung cleared him of a theft accusation and the horse demons were friendly after that.
